title: Committed app.bin: 2MB compiled binary added by the PR's HEAD commit (0118cc0)
evidence: git ls-files -s app.bin → "100755 4aaf130a4825b3b67a49e713b76ee83b9e244843 0	app.bin"; git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD -- app.bin → " app.bin | Bin 0 -> 2057480 bytes"; ls -la app.bin → "-rwxr-xr-x@ 1 moses staff 2057480 9 Aug 15:47 app.bin"; .gitignore lists only "tools/raylib-sw/" and "bin/" — app.bin is not excluded
detail: Round briefing: "The committed app.bin (2MB binary) — the 0118cc0 commit added a built binary to the repo. Build artifacts should not be committed (bloats the repo, platform-specific)." A macOS executable in a cross-platform repo, unprotected by .gitignore, so it will drift with every rebuild.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached app.bin, add "app.bin" to .gitignore (bin/ and tools/raylib-sw/ are already ignored), and rebuild from source per README.

title: error404 08000ms golden is byte-identical to boot 01000ms golden — the mid-run capture exercises no loss-path visuals
evidence: md5 goldens/boot/01000ms.png goldens/error404/08000ms.png → "86f328b6f6cc4d758c98512ac268397a" both; data/balance.json → "\"grace_window_ticks\": 200"; core/flow.odin:328 → "// E28: unroutable demand is not spawned — it accrues as"; core/crisis.odin → "if t.node_throughput[i] > 0 && i < len(f.node_load) {"; app/render/hud.odin → "fill := w * f32(snap.meter_pct) / 100"
detail: Byte-identical frames are CORRECT: grace (200 ticks) delays meter drain past tick 80; E28 blocks spawns without routes; strain needs throughput>0; no clock rendered. But the 8000ms capture exercises zero drain visuals — only the 40000ms lockup covers the loss path in T2 (T1 hashes do cover the drain).
recommended_fix: Move the error404 mid-run capture past the grace window (e.g. 24000ms, mid-drain) so T2 exercises the draining meter; keep 40000ms for the lockup.
